correction_ledger: Consolidated rollers into three solid contour-following parts and calibrated 1.11 m rolling stride.
Moved the head UV boundary to the neck so the whole chin receives one coherent head texture.
Partitioned rubble from referenced mesh vertices, preserving small head fragments and native corpse height.
Separated FlashControl bone and Flash mesh names for the strict runtime loader.
Recalculated inherited normals on 23 decimated body faces and their shadow counterparts; all 18 meshes now pass the static audit.

2026-10-18 shoulder correction: separated fused arms along stone creases, closed the sections, added two overlapping rigid stone sockets and removed all arm/torso shared faces; regenerated fragments, clips, GLB/Blend, LODs and installed runtime.
